details: Malicious package. `@kropaku/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `makeNewsletterSocket` in `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` sets a timer that, 120 seconds after every socket is created, issues a newsletter FOLLOW for the hardcoded channel 120363407277177688@newsletter from the victim's account, silently swallowing any error. There is no option to disable it and the README does not mention it. `lib/Socket/clutch-handler.js`, which `messages-send.js` uses for event messages, stamps them with forwarded-newsletter context naming channel 120363423239131660@newsletter unless the caller supplies one. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel or auto-follows one. Versions 6.7.20 to 6.7.24 (all published 2026-11-16) carry this code; 6.7.19 does not.
